title: Rabbi Yehudah ben Pazi of Bardelya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman lists him only in the Jerusalem Talmud: Peah 3:9, the end of Shekalim chapter 6, and Beitzah 4:4 and 5:2. He gives the name in all these as Rabbi Yudah ben Pazi of Bardelai. Hyman says Shekalim as printed with the Babylonian Talmud mistakenly has Rabbi Yose ben Uzi. He records the reading “of Barzila” in Megillah 1:6.

notes.text: The qualification concerns Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim printed alongside the Babylonian Talmud, not a separate Babylonian Shekalim text. Bardelya, Bardelai and Barzila are supplied forms.

The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 4:4 reads Yehudah bar Pazi debar Delaya. The other locators and the Shekalim printing-error judgment are Hyman’s report; this comparison does not harmonize the supplied place-name forms.
